item.title: Director of People Operations
item.description: A family-owned construction company, headquartered in Wichita, needs someone to lead its people team. Most of the foundation got built in the last 18 months, and the next director gets to build what’s still missing, starting with a performance management system that managers will use. Over time, the role grows into ownership of the company’s people strategy.

item.title: Director of Sales
item.description: A Hampton Roads contractor with decades of Navy work and shops that can take on far more than they carry today is hiring the person who will give its sales function structure. There is a rep, three estimators and a customer base, but no pipeline discipline and no playbook. The Director of Sales writes both, holds one of the five seats on the leadership team, and has the authority to hire. Year one is a selling year: take the long-cycle customer relationships off the President
